attempts.summary: Connected lan-a (10.10.10.0/24) and lan-b (10.20.20.0/24) through routed VyOS wg01 interfaces (10.255.255.0/30). Node3 serves the application at 10.10.10.10:8080; node4 reaches it from 10.20.20.10. Only new TCP/8080 connections to that application are permitted cross-LAN, established/related replies are allowed, and NAT is not configured. All four nodes passed sequential reboot-persistence verification.
